info.title: chromadotnet
info.description: The command chromadotnet: backup, restore and verify of Chroma collections through the API, with ChromaDotNet.Client.Backup. Tested with Chroma 1.5.9, VecturaDB and Chroma Cloud. Independent project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Chroma Inc. CHROMA is a registered trademark of Chroma Inc., used here only to describe compatibility.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Backup, restore and verify of Chroma collections through the API, tested with Chroma 1.5.9, VecturaDB and Chroma Cloud. A backup of a server that takes writes meanwhile can hold records of different moments.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: backup
commands.description: Saves collections of a database into a zip file. If the server takes writes meanwhile, the file can hold records of different moments: the command then says so and exits with 2.

options.name: --url
options.description: The address of the server, like http://localhost:8000 or https://api.trychroma.com.

options.name: --token
options.description: The API key or token, sent as X-Chroma-Token. Without it, the environment variable CHROMA_API_KEY, so that it stays out of the history of the shell.

options.name: --tenant
options.description: The tenant. Without it, CHROMA_TENANT; on Chroma Cloud the one of the API key; otherwise default_tenant.

options.name: --database
options.description: The database. Without it, CHROMA_DATABASE; on Chroma Cloud the one of the API key, when it has one; otherwise default_database.

options.name: --distributed
options.description: The server is distributed Chroma, not on Chroma Cloud. [default: False]

options.name: --all
options.description: Every collection of the database. [default: False]

options.name: --collections
options.description: A collection to save, once for each one; or --all.

options.name: --out
options.description: The file of the backup, which must not exist.

options.name: --batch
options.description: The records of one request, from 1 to 300. [default: 100]

options.name: --concurrent
options.description: The gets at the same time, from 1 to 8. [default: 5]

commands.name: restore
commands.description: Writes the collections of a backup into a database. Every collection that exists is compared first; one that is not the same is changed only with --resume or --force.

options.name: --url
options.description: The address of the server, like http://localhost:8000 or https://api.trychroma.com.

options.name: --token
options.description: The API key or token, sent as X-Chroma-Token. Without it, the environment variable CHROMA_API_KEY, so that it stays out of the history of the shell.

options.name: --tenant
options.description: The tenant. Without it, CHROMA_TENANT; on Chroma Cloud the one of the API key; otherwise default_tenant.

options.name: --database
options.description: The database. Without it, CHROMA_DATABASE; on Chroma Cloud the one of the API key, when it has one; otherwise default_database.

options.name: --distributed
options.description: The server is distributed Chroma, not on Chroma Cloud. [default: False]

options.name: --in
options.description: The file of the backup.

options.name: --collections
options.description: A collection of the backup, once for each one; without it, all of them.

options.name: --resume
options.description: A collection that exists and is not the same gets the records it does not have; the rest of it stays. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: A collection that exists and is not the same becomes the same as the backup. [default: False]

options.name: --yes
options.description: With --resume or --force, without asking. [default: False]

options.name: --batch
options.description: The records of one request, from 1 to 300. [default: 100]

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Compares the collections of a backup with the ones of a database, and exits with 2 when they are not the same. It writes nothing.
